clues.text: Riding a mule into battle, this son of King David caught his head fast in the branches of an oak.
This son of David planned Amnon's death from the day Amnon violated his sister Tamar.
Greeting Israelites who came to King David for justice, this prince stole the hearts of the men of Israel.
In the chamber over the gate, King David wept and wished he had died instead of this son.
When this son of David cut his heavy hair each year, it weighed two hundred shekels.
No man in all Israel was as handsome or highly praised as this son of David.
This son of David had his servants set fire to Joab's barley field, which was next to his own.
